notes: Cash basis (modified cash) county; governmental funds only, business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from the Totals column of the governmental funds statement (p4); transfers gross (in 706,270 / out 706,270). Fund balances printed (p4): beginning 4,830,942, ending 6,191,084; roll-forward ties. Ending cash = Equity in pooled cash and cash equivalents 4,423,177 (p3); certificates of deposit 1,767,907 as ending_investments; no prior-year cash printed, beginning_cash null. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (totals equal the Statement of Net Position, 6,191,084), fund balance by classification; no liabilities. 'Local fees, licenses, commissions and miscellaneous' uses the user's label decision (licenses and permits), as in FY2023; Inheritance Tax Fund receipts printed under that line kept as printed. Statement 'Public works' 2,067,897 mapped to streets/highways as in FY2023 (Road Fund 1,994,625 plus Noxious Weed 73,272). Detail: FY2022 prints an individual budgetary comparison schedule for every fund (General pp5-9 by department, Road p10, Inheritance Tax p11, COVID ARP p12, and each nonmajor fund pp13-28); these replace the combining-schedule source FY2023 used (no combining schedule in this trim). Per-fund schedules tie to the Other Governmental Funds column (receipts 506,894, disbursements 357,910, transfers in 190,607). Zero-actual lines and zero totals not recorded (e.g. Equipment rental budget in Road Fund, capital outlay budgets with no actual, Drug Law Fund no activity, COVID capital outlay 0). Nonmajor operating-expense functions taken from the statement's Other Governmental Funds function lines (computed notes). COVID ARP and FEMA fund intergovernmental receipts recorded as federal grants from fund names; other Intergovernmental lines stay other state aid. p29 (tax certified schedule of all subdivisions) not used.
